r.interpretation:
BEST-SUPPORTED EXPLANATION OF Pi (a proof modulo two inputs that I verified numerically at both primes).

1. Normal form. Pi = { Delta = M_0^-1 (zhat D_1) M_0 : D_1 a symmetric Z/5-covariant 5x5 matrix with D_1 phi_3 = 0 }, plus one order-6 direction that no condition sees. Here phi_m = (zeta^(m j))_j is the Fourier basis of colour space; the zhat^0 rows of the hatted theory identify phi_m with the flat class Hhat^(m-1) (unit = phi_1, H = phi_2, H^2 = phi_3, H^3 = phi_4, H^4 = phi_0, pairing m <-> -m). A covariant symmetric D_1 is a psi-free propagator alpha H(x)H + beta (1(x)H^2 + H^2(x)1) + gamma (H^3(x)H^4 + H^4(x)H^3); Pi is alpha = 0. So the vector f = phi_3 of the task is H^2, the dual of the marginal class H, and the right statement is in the LEFT placement: M = exp(u zhat D_1 + ...) R~(zhat;u), R' = Psi(u) (1 - u zhat D_1) + O(u^2).
Tests: M_0 A M_0^-1 and M_0 B M_0^-1 have no components of zhat-orders 2..5 and hat c_1(3) = 0; A, B minus M_0^-1 (zhat D_1) M_0 are pure order-6 elements killed by the genus-3 rows; conversely all 18 conditions vanish for 6 random (beta, gamma); rank test span(A,B) = this family mod order 6 (t1_fourier.py, t3_pi.py, both primes).

2. Mechanism. For any Delta, [u^1] E'(m,n) = (-1)^(n+1) D_{m+n+1} with D = M_0 Delta M_0^-1 (checked on the code's edge tables, both primes). For D = zhat D_1 only E'(0,0) is non-zero at u^1 (checked), so for an E-edge graph [u^E] G_Gamma = (1/|Aut|) Sum_colourings prod_v <e_i ...>^{Lambda_0}_{g_v,n_v} prod_e (D_1)_{ij}: a contraction of PRIMARY (psi-free, top-degree) correlators of the frozen vertex theory Lambda_0 = M_0.omega^ with a propagator whose two ends lie in W = span(1, H^2, H^3, H^4) = phi_3-perp (never H).
Input (P), computed with MVertex6 at both primes (t2_primary.py): for (g,n) = (1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3) the only non-zero primary correlator is <H,...,H>_g = 1/12, 1/12, 1/6, 1/2; 1/600, 1/200, 1/50, i.e. the t-derivatives of -(1/12) log t and (1/1200) t^-2: at genus >= 1 the primary sector of Lambda_0 is the one-variable conifold free energy in the direction H. Genus 0 is richer ((0,4): 5 components, (0,5): 4), but (0,6) has only <H^6> and <H,(H^2)^5>, both containing H.
Every genus-3 graph with E <= 3 (and every genus-2 graph with E = 1) either has a vertex of genus >= 1 carrying a half-edge, or is the single (0,6) vertex (graph 4). Hence every term vanishes, linearly in D_1: this is why the solution set contains a LINEAR space although 18 conditions on 15 unknowns have negative expected dimension. The same mechanism gives m_1 = x (hat c^D_1(3) - (5/2) hat c^D_2(4)) (checked), so Pi lies in m_1 = 0.

3. Predictions tested. (a) Full class: every symmetric D_1 with D_1 phi_3 = 0, covariant or not (10 parameters, propagator in Sym^2 W), should solve all N_1-conditions: confirmed at 2 random points per prime (4 linear rows, the 5 stored 75-variable quadrics, and direct evaluation of all 16 edge graphs with E <= 3 including graph 4) (t4_full.py). (b) Controls: random symmetric D_1 fails all 16 graphs; H(x)x + x(x)H with x in W fails exactly graphs 6, 9, 10, 18, 20, 32 (those where a genus-0 vertex absorbs the W-ends), as the selection rules predict; a covariant D_1 with alpha != 0 fails all 18 conditions.

4. The two directions are different in nature.
beta (string direction, H -> 1, H^3 -> H^2): D_beta^2 = 0 and D_beta 1 = 0, so R' = Psi(u)(1 - u zhat D_beta) exactly, every edge is u D_beta with the unit at one psi-free end, no leaves; by the string equation of the vertex CohFT, and eta(x,y) = 0 for x, y in {1, H^2} at (0,3) vertices, every edge graph vanishes identically at every genus: an exact gauge direction (a second trivial factorisation). Checked: M = exp(u zhat D_beta) R~(zhat;u) with true u-dependent vertices gives [u^0..u^3] = 0 on all 16 graphs (prime 61); frozen eps-expansion identically zero through eps^6 on 15 graphs.
gamma (1 -> H^4 -> H^3): only the leading order is explained by (P). Empirically the exact left dressing M = exp(u zhat D_1) R~(zhat;u) at a random point of Pi makes all 16 edge graphs with E <= 3 O(u^4) (prime 61 all 16; prime 89 the 14 graphs other than 3 and 4), so each point of Pi is the first-order term of an explicit regularising factorisation with N_2, N_3 fixed by BCH. This is not an exact symmetry: in the frozen theory the sums for exp(eps zhat D_1) M_0 vanish through eps^3 but graphs 2, 3, 7, 10 are non-zero at eps^4..eps^6. The vanishing at orders 2 and 3 for gamma is unexplained.

5. Hypotheses refuted (t3_pi.py, t5_stab.py). Annihilating the unit: no (D_1 1 = gamma H^4). Right-placed Delta annihilating phi_3 to all orders: no (only order 1); left-placed 'D phi_3 = 0 to all orders' is necessary but not sufficient (pure order 2, H^4 -> H^2, fails c_9). zhat-rescaling M_0^-1 zhat M_0' (either placement), u-rescaling (N_1^taut), mu_0, its graded pieces, Ad of their order-1 parts: none in Pi, each fails 8 to 18 conditions (hat c_1(3) = 9/20 for mu_0, -1/5 for N_1^taut). Stabiliser of the vertex theory: no; exp(eps zhat D_1).Lambda_0 changes F_2, F_3 when gamma != 0 and acquires <H^3,H^4>_1 != 0 even along beta (F_2, F_3 unchanged along beta only). Accident of counting: no for the leading order (structural, given (P)).

6. Meaning for the programme. Pi is kinematic: it is the tautological factorisation left-dressed by primary propagators that avoid the only direction (H) in which the conifold-limit vertex theory has higher-genus primary correlators; the excluded H(x)H propagator is the holomorphic-anomaly-type one. Pi is therefore not an independent Hodge-type factorisation. Not established: (P) beyond the listed (g,n); the genus-0 contractions needed at genus 4 ((0,8), (0,7)+(0,3), (0,6)+(0,4), (0,5)+(0,5)); any reason for the gamma direction beyond leading order.
